label: D1 reward-received, about to choose a2, low value (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded), and essentially only when the agent is about to choose a2 (its own upcoming choice; 33583/33594 active steps; prev_action==2 alone gives recall 0.80 since most trials are stays). D1 & rewarded & action==2 has recall 1.00 but precision 0.26; the remaining selectivity is that it fires mostly when the model value at D1 is low, which is concentrated late in the episode (rate rises from ~0 in trials 0-9 to 9% of steps in trials 80-99; value<7.13 holds 85% of mass). Adding value<7.13 gives dev F1 0.69 (P 0.61, R 0.79, mass 0.85); ep_trial>=70 instead gives similar F1 0.70. Top activations tend to be the first reward after a run of unrewarded (often rare) a2 trials; repeated consecutive rewards give smaller activations. Never fires at D1 after no reward, when about to choose a1, or on GO/D2. Recorded predicate uses only observed/computed quantities (reward input, own upcoming choice, own value output).
